quarterly_data.signal: Ferrotec's consolidated subsidiary Hangzhou Dahe Thermo-Magnetics Electronics concluded a strategic collaboration agreement with InnoLight (Zhongji Innolight), a provider of optical interconnect solutions for AI data centers (AIDC), covering the supply and joint development of TECs (thermoelectric coolers), submounts and other products, and collaboration in the technology and material fields needed for other AIDC optical-interconnect products: product cooperation, joint R&D, supply-chain coordination and commercialization cooperation in new AI interconnect, new device and new material fields. The filing names InnoLight as one of the main customers of Ferrotec's TEC products. The board resolved on October 20, 2026; the agreement date and the start of the collaboration are given as during October 2026 (planned). The company positions the collaboration as an important step to expand TEC business opportunities and strengthen its business base in AIDC optical-interconnect devices and materials; the impact on consolidated results from the fiscal year ending December 2026 onward will be assessed as concrete transactions and joint development progress.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: customer (TEC products) and strategic collaboration partner
